title: 茶水间英文 - 11月23日 | 股市惊魂反弹、量子破不可能、曼联四球惨败
description:
Wall Street just lived through its worst week in eighteen months, with twelve trillion dollars wiped from global markets, before a sharp rebound on Monday morning after Nvidia's board brought Jensen Huang back as CEO just eleven days after he resigned. Google's quantum chip beat a game that is mathematically impossible to win, and Liverpool thrashed Manchester United four nil in Mauricio Pochettino's nightmare debut. Plus a random question: if you could rewind one conversation by ten seconds, which one would you pick?

华尔街刚经历了十八个月来最惨的一周，全球股市蒸发十二万亿美元，周一早上又强劲反弹——英伟达董事会在黄仁勋辞职仅十一天后就把他请了回来；谷歌量子芯片赢下了一场数学上不可能赢的游戏，利物浦则在波切蒂诺的首秀里四比零横扫曼联。今天还有一个随机问题：如果你能把人生中的某段对话倒回十秒，你会改哪一句？

Words to steal 生词本：
- correction — 回调；从高点下跌超过百分之十
- dead cat bounce — 死猫反弹；暴跌后的短暂回升
- wipe out — 一扫而光；抹掉
- entanglement — 量子纠缠
- milestone — 里程碑
- thrash — 痛击；大胜
- sent off — 被红牌罚下
- relegation zone — 降级区
